metaTitle: Custom Pocketed Sweaters & Cardigans | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom pocketed sweaters and cardigans at Perfect Imprints. Bulk pricing, embroidery, and screen printing available.
introHtml: Pocketed sweaters and cardigans combine comfort with utility, giving your team a place to store a phone, badge, or pen while keeping a polished look. The Women's Boxercraft Cuddle Cardigan offers a soft, cozy feel with front pockets, while the Ladies' Mercer+Mettle Open Front Cardigan Sweater provides a professional drape and handy side pockets. Whether you need employee uniforms or client gifts, these styles accept embroidery or screen printing for a clean branded finish.
heroAltText: Custom pocketed sweaters cardigans with embroidered logo on front pocket, ideal for corporate apparel.
